html:
Remark. Significance: chirality is the unique S-odd channel, trivial in the commutative limit

Remark (significance). The Frobenius--Hopf antipode is trivial in the commutative QOU (S = \mathrm{id} when the multiplication is commutative), so any S-anti-invariant degree of freedom must vanish. The chirality \Phi_3 — the unique S-odd channel by Frobenius S-classification — is therefore identically zero in the classical limit, and the mass formula degenerates to the two surviving S-even invariants \Phi_1 (trace) and \Phi_2 (determinant).
